verdict.rationale: Daytona provides SDKs (Python/TypeScript), CLI, REST API (OpenAPI), and an MCP server explicitly designed for AI agents to programmatically create sandboxes, execute code (stateless or stateful), retrieve results, and destroy sandboxes — all without human intervention. Docs emphasize millisecond provisioning/teardown and agent-first design, with the MCP server explicitly supporting Claude, Cursor, Windsurf agents for this exact workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full agent-driven provision→execute→teardown loop (community evidence covers older SSH/dev-environment use cases, not the sandbox/code-execution API).
